acceptance.dimension.tolerance.summary: A printed part passes the Phase 1 dimensional check if each named dimension is within this of its design value.

color.glue.clearance_mm.summary: Gap per side between a glue piece and its pocket (the nominal clearance). Each piece is the pocket's shape buffered inwards by this much (round joins), then eroded wherever the measured gap is short, so before snapping to the storage grid the gap is at least this (to float64 rounding). The built gap is at least this minus the grid snaps (a few micrometres); F4.glue_fit gates it.

color.glue.min_piece_side_mm.summary: Smallest glue piece, as the side of a square. A piece whose area after shrinking by the clearance is below this squared (4 mm^2 at 2 mm) is folded into its neighbour with the longest shared boundary, and gets no pocket of its own.

color.skin.depth_mm.summary: Depth of the colored top skin. Colors other than the base sit only in the top this-many mm of a flat print, on a full-thickness base of the base color; for the glue route it is also the pocket depth and the piece thickness.

fdm.wall.min_thickness.summary: Minimum wall thickness, two perimeters with a 0.4 mm nozzle.

flat.island.min_square_side.summary: Drop traced islands whose area is below (this many nozzle widths)^2.

flat.sliver.opening_width.summary: Shrink then regrow each shape by half this width to delete slivers narrower than it (an opening).

flat.smooth.sigma_px.summary: Gaussian blur (in image pixels) applied to the binary mask before taking its 0.5 iso-contour, to smooth jagged outlines of soft or low-resolution images.

format.3mf.consistent_orientation.summary: Adjacent triangles have the same face-normal orientation, and all normals point outward.

format.3mf.edge_manifold.summary: Every triangle edge is shared with exactly one other triangle (no holes, no non-manifold edges).

gate.topology.vertex_manifold.summary: Require every vertex to be manifold (no two surfaces pinched together at a single point).

perception.alpha.min_opaque.summary: A pixel counts as opaque image content if its 8-bit alpha is at least this.

slicer.orca.max_triangles_per_plate.summary: Triangle limit per plate declared by OrcaSlicer's --mtcpp option (default value); used here as our F5 budget.

slicer.orca.timeout_s.summary: Wall-clock limit for one OrcaSlicer run in tdmg slice; a run still going after this long is stopped and reported as a failure.

slicer.prusa.timeout_s.summary: Wall-clock limit for each PrusaSlicer run (--info, then --export-gcode) in tdmg slice's F6.portability; a run still going after this long is stopped and F6.portability FAILs.

threshold.rule: (a) layer tool sets = body sets; (b) one run per tool per layer; (c) changes = sum(bodies - 1) + boundaries where the tool differs; one start load, the first tool of layer 1
